# The map of packages/generate

One line per file, in what the file says of itself. The kinds of folder are in [README.md](../README.md).

## `src/`

- [`blueprint-text.ts`](../src/blueprint-text.ts): The text helpers of the blueprint's generated indexes (./blueprint.ts): where each goes, how it names the modules it imports, and how a list too long for one line is broken, as oxfmt breaks it, so no generated file is formatted after.
- [`blueprint.ts`](../src/blueprint.ts): The text of the blueprint's generated indexes (packages/blueprint/src/generated/), from its things' folders as the toolkit reads them (`layoutOf`) and today's domains (sources.ts, `BLUEPRINT.domains`).
- [`delta.entry.ts`](../src/delta.entry.ts): `pnpm delta:check`: prints each finding of the delta check (the toolkit's, run over the blueprint, which passes itself in), one a line, and fails when there is one.
- [`docs-render.ts`](../src/docs-render.ts): The text of the docs' generated blocks and of the design notes' list, from their owners' facts.
- [`main.ts`](../src/main.ts): `pnpm generate`'s writer: reads each owner (Foundry's out/, the deployment record, the seed, the blueprint) and writes every derived file whose text changed, printing each one it wrote; with --check (`pnpm generate:check`) it writes nothing and fails when any would change.
- [`markdown-blocks.ts`](../src/markdown-blocks.ts): Blocks inside hand-written Markdown files: the lines between `<!-- generated:<name> start -->` and `<!-- generated:<name> end -->` are the generator's, everything else is the file's own (docs/design/docs.md, section 5).
- [`pipeline.ts`](../src/pipeline.ts): The text of the blueprint's pipeline index (packages/blueprint/src/generated/pipeline.ts): every verb that is work no door serves, from its thing's folder as the toolkit reads it (`layoutOf`), and the names of the things that do only such work.
- [`ratchet-files.entry.ts`](../src/ratchet-files.entry.ts): The repository's files ratchets R7, R8 and R10 are counted from (packages/blueprint-tools, src/checks/ ratchet-files.ts): the blueprint's verbs, the long READMEs the docs' shape lists, the tracked READMEs and package docs (git's list of them), each package's runtime dependencies, and what `capxul/effect-only` finds, run by oxlint alone (packages/lint/effect-only.json) on the TypeScript the lint does not reach.
- [`ratchet-sources.ts`](../src/ratchet-sources.ts): The repository's own ratchet lists and scorecard inputs, as ratchets.ts and scorecard.ts read them: the blueprint's registry and operations, the delta check's formats, lint's unmigrated lists, and the glossary's old words as generated/old-words.json counts them, and the repository's files R7, R8 and R10 are counted from.
- [`ratchets.entry.ts`](../src/ratchets.entry.ts): `pnpm ratchets`: prints every ratchet of the blueprint's registry with its count now, and fails when a counted list grew over its committed count (packages/blueprint/generated/ratchets.json).
- [`render.ts`](../src/render.ts): The text of each generated file, from its owner's facts.
- [`seed.ts`](../src/seed.ts): `pnpm seed`'s builder: starts anvil from the pinned third-party state (`state/pin.genesis.json`, no network), sends the seed's eight transactions (src/seed/steps.ts), each in its own block at a fixed time with fixed fees and signed with anvil's public test keys, dumps the state, and writes `state/core.json`, `deployments/devnet.json` and `state/CHECKSUMS` where they changed.
- [`sources.ts`](../src/sources.ts): What `pnpm generate` writes, and from what.
- [`words.entry.ts`](../src/words.entry.ts): `pnpm words`, the gate of the rename ratchet R15 "Old words", counted in distinct names (its entry in packages/blueprint/src/ratchets.ts; docs/roadmap.md, item 3.8; `pnpm ratchets` only reports its total): counts every old word of the glossary (old-words.ts says what counts) and fails when one grew past its committed count, in packages/blueprint/generated/old-words.json, which `pnpm generate` writes.

## `src/seed/`

- [`plan.ts`](../src/seed/plan.ts): Where the seed's deployment puts everything, from the manifest, Companies House's configuration and the compiled contracts: Companies House is a Safe made by the pin's Safe proxy factory, its Roles module is made by the ModuleProxyFactory, and each manifest entry is created by Companies House through CreateCall's CREATE2, so every address is a function of the house, the entry's salt and its compiled init code.
- [`record.ts`](../src/seed/record.ts): The deployment record (`deployments/devnet.json`) and the state's checksums (`state/CHECKSUMS`), from what the seed planned and what the chain holds after it.
- [`safe.ts`](../src/seed/safe.ts): Safe transactions as the seed sends them: the EIP-712 hash each owner signs (computed here, not read from the Safe), the signatures in ascending owner order, `execTransaction`'s calldata, and MultiSend's packing.
- [`steps.ts`](../src/seed/steps.ts): The seed's eight transactions, in order, each in its own block: (1) the Safe proxy factory creates Companies House, (2) the ModuleProxyFactory makes its Roles module, (3-6) Companies House creates the manifest's contracts through CreateCall, four to a Safe transaction, (7) it wires Budgets to Agreements, (8) it enables Roles and scopes each tier's claim and company roles.
- [`third-party.ts`](../src/seed/third-party.ts): The third-party contracts the seed's deployment calls, at the addresses `test/fork/Addresses.sol` pins on Base Sepolia; each has code in `state/pin.genesis.json`.
